answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the trellis of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, clawed back after a replayed submission, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The bridge is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the shale.
